description:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team. 
 
 
 Broadridge is hiring! We are seeking a Software Developer to support, enhance, and maintain intelligent document processing, workflow, and imaging solutions with a primary focus on Tungsten TotalAgility (TTA). This role is ideal for a mid-level developer with hands-on experience in workflow automation, document processing, and system integration, along with imaging, and AI-enabled intelligent document processing. Also, basic .NET development skills and familiarity with AWS services.

 The ideal candidate is interested in enterprise automation, intelligent document processing, and developing solutions that streamline business operations and improve information capture.

 Responsibilities

 Support, configure, and enhance Kofax Capture and Tungsten TotalAgility (TTA) solutions for document capture, classification, extraction, validation, and workflow automation
 Design and maintain TTA workflows, business rules, queues, forms, and process automation components utilizing imaging, and AI-enabled intelligent document processing.
 Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to document ingestion, OCR/extraction, validation, exception handling, and system performance
 Assist with integration of TTA with downstream business systems, databases, APIs, and cloud services
 Develop and maintain supporting customizations using .NET / C#
 Support existing Kofax Capture solutions as needed, particularly where they integrate with or feed into TTA
 Collaborate with business stakeholders and technical teams to gather requirements and implement process improvements
 Participate in testing, deployment, production support, and ongoing optimization of workflow solutions
 Create and maintain technical documentation for TTA configurations, workflows, and integrations
 
 Qualifications

 Hands-on experience with Tungsten TotalAgility (TTA) , including workflow/process design and document-processing capabilities
 Experience with document capture, OCR, classification, extraction, and validation workflows
 Basic to intermediate development experience with .NET / C#
 Familiarity with AWS services and cloud-hosted application environments
 Exposure to or experience with AI/ML concepts, intelligent document processing, or automation technologies
 Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills
 Ability to work collaboratively across business and technical teams
 Good written and verbal communication skills
 
 Preferred Qualifications

 Experience with Kofax Capture migration or integration scenarios involving TTA
 Familiarity with TTA integrations, APIs, web services, or middleware
 Experience with SQL and relational databases
 Exposure to intelligent document processing (IDP), case management, or enterprise workflow platforms
 Experience supporting production automation solutions in an enterprise environment
 
 Compensation Range: The salary range for this position is between $140,000 - $150,000
 Bonus Eligibility: Bonus Eligible
 Broadridge considers various factors when evaluating a candidate's final salary including, but not limited to, relevant experience, skills, and education.

 Benefits Information: Please visit www.broadridgebenefits.com for more information on our comprehensive benefit offerings.

 All Colorado employees receive paid sick leave in compliance with the Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act and other legally required benefits, as applicable.  Apply by clicking the application link and submitting your information. The deadline to apply for this role is December 1, 2026
